overview: EZmailout.com — direct mail campaigns without minimums. A $9/month membership unlocks wholesale Click2Mail print rates (postcards from $1.15), an AI design studio with a pay-as-you-go credit ledger, saved audience presets, dynamic QR tracking and referral rewards, all on a single Motoko canister.
features: 5-product catalog with a 100%–140% margin pricing ledger (postcards 4×6/6×9/6×11, letters, bifold/trifold self-mailers, snap packs, booklets)
Dual-path audience targeting: interactive Leaflet radius map with EDDM-style estimates, CSV upload with Click2Mail CASS verification, and saved audience presets (re-run, prune, save as new)
Side-by-side design studio: 2D drag-and-drop editor with bleed/cut/safe overlays and a synchronized 3D front/back preview
AI Studio: DALL·E 3 backgrounds with industry quick-prompts and a GPT-4o mini copywriter, paid with credits (Stripe top-up packs, 50 free credits per member month)
Dynamic QR & link creator with per-recipient tracking redirects (ezmailout.com/t/{recipientId}) and scan analytics
Stripe Elements checkout for campaign orders, credit packs and the $9/month membership; referral program granting one free month per referred first payment
Click2Mail REST fulfilment: 300 DPI PDF upload, address list intake, job dispatch with print options, IMb tracking sync and authenticated delivery webhook
Campaign portal with a 5-stage USPS timeline, CSV export, production status and admin key management
